items.html: And then, at the time of the first Ibur, at its end, at the time of birth, second Mochin of Ruach come out; and since they enter only through the Yenika, they are therefore called Mochin of Yenika — but certainly an Ibur preceded them, as above. And afterward, for the third Mochin of Gadlut, there was a third Ibur; but relative to the Yenika it is only a second Ibur. And understand very much.
